svg.title: Test sequence before first switch-on
svg.text: EXAMPLE – real design by a qualified electrician
Values from docs/27 and web/instelec_calc.js (example data, crankcase machining line ML1).
Initial verification of the HMC-01 supply – order of tests, instrument and example limit (dead tests first, then live tests)
cable type/size, glands, torque marks, labels, SPD, IP
2-pole voltage tester, test it before and after
500 V DC – drives, SPD, filters OFF
2 LIVE TESTS (upstream ON, machine main switch OFF)
loop tester, at the main switch
RCD tester: t at I_Δn, 5·I_Δn, ramp
main switch lockable OFF, e-stop, phase relay, SPD status
limit: ΔT < 10 K vs similar parts
SLD, settings record, PQ + PE-current baseline
Blue arrow 6 → 7: ENERGISE only after all dead tests pass (machine main switch OFF, warning signs, second person).
Any FAIL → stop, find the cause, repair, repeat the failed test AND every earlier test the repair could affect (e.g. insulation after re-termination).
Insulation test: disconnect or bridge drives, SPDs and EMC filters first – 500 V DC can damage electronics; Y-capacitors give false low readings.
